subject: prd/parallel-memory
statement: Mitigate accidental debt changes by requiring an exact trusted v1 inventory and a separate data-only v2 migration after the compatible reader lands.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The approved baseline design retains exact inventory and monotonic comparison. The implementation must reject mixed source/code migrations, bootstrap, downgrade, malformed policy, and missing historical inputs.
fit_criterion: The baseline policy and synchronization tests must preserve every normalized allowance on migration and refuse changed counts, addresses, severities, repairability, unsupported evaluators, or unavailable replay inputs.
